name: workspace-app
description: Configure the Workspace App layout, main action, forms and internal links to Agent Chat, Workflow or Automation.
preload_summary: To design or redesign the App page, command the App designer with operation `design_app` and a brief, then accept its draft with `apply_draft`, send it back with feedback, or discard it. For a small named change, start with operation `get_current`, then use `app_view.update` in a reviewed draft for App entries, targets, forms, layout, or the primary action. Use returned action keys and catalog IDs; an App entry does not require a Workspace Service. Attach a saved Workflow with `workflow_binding.attach` in that same draft. Preserve unrelated App settings and verify the persisted result after approval. For data components, project records, publication metrics, display metadata, or media bindings, call `invoke_skill(skill_id="workspace-app", input=<current request>)` to load the complete guide before drafting.
